raw_segments.text: Their eyes watched him. On the slow, weedy waterway he had floated on his raft coastward
over Ireland drawn by a hollage rope past beds of reeds, over slime, mud-choked bottles,
carrion dogs. Athlon, mullinger, moivoli, I could make a walking tour to see Millie
by the canal, or cycle down. Hire some old croc, safety. Ren had one the other day at
the auction but a lady's, developing waterways. James M. Can's hobby to row me over the ferry.
Cheaper transit. By easy stages. Houseboats. Camping out. Also hearses. To heaven by water.
Perhaps I will without writing. Come as a surprise, lakeslip clinsilla, dropping down
lock by lock to Dublin, with turf from the Midland bogs. Salute. He lifted his brown straw hat,
